defect_observations.observation: Suspected correctness defect (not a coverage gap): item (6) of thm:p15-w02b-p15-013-comparison states that, under convergence in probability, L^p convergence holds if and only if X_n in L^p for every n and (|X_n|^p) is uniformly integrable. With Definition def:p15-w02b-p15-013-modes, which does not require X_n or X in L^p, the 'only if' fails: e.g. X not in L^p and X_n = X + 1/n gives E|X_n - X|^p = n^{-p} -> 0 with no X_n in L^p; or X_1 outside L^p and X_n = X in L^p for n >= 2. The annex (lines 198-199) reduces (6) to thm:p15-w02b-p15-013-vitali, which assumes X_n in L^p as a hypothesis, so the stated 'only if' is not what is proved. Suggested fix: add the hypothesis X_n in L^p for every n (or X in L^p and 'for all large n').
